labels: AI by-eye labels (WP3 part 2), test video: scoring only
rule: as for the dev clip and the agreed boundary cases: event frame = first frame whose centre (960, 540) shows the other side of the surface; crossing = frames in between. Snell's window just under the surface (sky through the surface, brown reflection of the back) = underwater; half-out phase (circular waterline rim on the dome, centre in the brownish water-film band) = crossing; after that, water sheets / waves over the lens with sky visible = air. Entries: crossing = water sheet / dark surface band over the lens; event = first frame with entry froth or water at the centre.
